IRS990.MissionDesc: ANGELS FOSTER FAMILY NETWORK'S MISSION IS TO PASSIONATELY AND COLLABORATIVELY CARE FOR CHILDREN FIVE AND YOUNGER WITH DIVERSE AND EXCEPTIONAL FAMILIES WHO DEDICATE THEMSELVES TO EACH CHILD'S WELL-BEING.
IRS990.Desc: ANGELS RECRUITS, TRAINS, AND APPROVES THE MOST HIGHLY QUALIFIED INDIVIDUALS AND FAMILIES TO BECOME RESOURCE (FOSTER) PARENTS, ENSURING THAT INFANTS AND TODDLERS ENTERING FOSTER CARE ARE PLACED IN SAFE, STABLE, AND LOVING HOMES. IN 2024, 518 FAMILIES CONTACTED ANGELS TO INQUIRE ABOUT FOSTERING, AND 197 FAMILIES ATTENDED AN INFORMATION SESSION, 45 OF WHOM APPLIED TO BECOME A RESOURCE FAMILY, 9 OF THESE FAMILIES COMPLETED TRAINING AND 9 WERE APPROVED. A TOTAL OF 19 CHILDREN WERE PLACED WITH AN ANGELS' RESOURCE FAMILY IN 2024. ADDITIONALLY, 2 CHILDREN WERE TRANSFERRED TO THE HIGHER-LEVEL INTENSIVE SERVICES FOSTER CARE (ISFC) PROGRAM, AND 36 CHILDREN WERE DISCHARGED FROM OUR CARE, INCLUDING 5 AT THE ISFC RATE. OVERALL, 50 CHILDREN WERE SERVED IN THIS PROGRAM IN 2024, WITH AN ADDITIONAL 7 SERVED AT THE ISFC RATE.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: ANGELS RECRUITS, TRAINS, AND APPROVES THE MOST HIGHLY QUALIFIED INDIVIDUALS AND FAMILIES TO BECOME RESOURCE (FOSTER) PARENTS, ENSURING THAT INFANTS AND TODDLERS ENTERING FOSTER CARE ARE PLACED IN SAFE, STABLE, AND LOVING HOMES. SOME OF THESE CHILDREN QUALIFY TO BE PLACED WITH US UNDER THE INTENSIVE SERVICES FOSTER CARE (ISFC) RATE, WHICH REQUIRES EXTRA TRAINING FOR OUR RESOURCE FAMILIES AND IS CONSIDERED A SEPARATE PROGRAM UNDER OUR LICENSE AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA. IN 2024, 2 ADDITIONAL CHILDREN WERE TRANSFERRED TO THE ISFC PROGRAM WITH A TOTAL OF 5 CHILDREN BEING DISCHARGED DURING THE YEAR. A TOTAL OF 7 OUT OF OUR APPROVED 86 FAMILIES HAD CHILDREN IN THEIR CARE UNDER THIS PROGRAM.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE AGENCY IS A PUBLIC CHARITY AND IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE AGENCY BELIEVES IT HAS APPROPRIATE SUPPORT FOR ANY TAX POSITIONS TAKEN; AS SUCH, IT DOES NOT HAVE ANY MATERIAL UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS OR LIABILITIES AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.
ANGELS USES A COMBINATION OF REPORTING THE NUMBER OF CONTRIBUTORS, THE NUMBER OF INSTANCES OF CONTRIBUTIONS, OR THE NUMBER OF ITEMS RECEIVED DEPENDING ON THE QUANTITY AND TYPES OF ITEMS RECEIVED.
ANGELS USES A THIRD PARTY COMMERCIAL FUNDRAISER, CHARITABLE ADULT RIDES & SERVICES, TO SELL ANY CARS DONATED TO THE ORGANIZATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR AND THE CONTROLLER WHO THEN MEET WITH THE AUDIT COMMITTEE TO REVIEW THE FORM FOR ACCURACY AND RECONCILIATION TO THE INDEPENDENT FINANCIAL AUDIT. THE AUDIT CHAIR THEN REVIEWS THE FORM 990 AND PRESENTS IT TO THE BOARD FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS SUBJECT TO AN ANNUAL REVIEW AND ELECTION BY THE BOARD MEMBERS. THEY ARE ALSO BOUND BY THE POLICY AND HAVE A DUTY TO DISCLOSE ANY CONFLICTS DURING THE YEAR AND NOT JUST WHEN THE ANNUAL REVIEWS TAKE PLACE. IF A PERSON HAS A CONFLICT WITH RESPECT TO A TRANSACTION, THEY ARE NOT ALLOWED TO VOTE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION FOR THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR INCLUDES USE OF COMPARABLE DATA OF LIKE ORGANIZAIONS AND APPROVAL BY INDEPENDENT BOARD MEMBERS; THE PROCESS WAS DOCUMENTED. THIS WAS LAST DONE JANUARY 2023, WHICH WAS THE LAST TIME THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR HAD A SALARY INCREASE. OTHER SALARIES ARE REVIEWED ANNUALLY DURING OUR BUDGET PROCESS AT WHICH TIME COMPARABLE MARKET SALARIES ARE CONSULTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 AND THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE POSTED ON THE ORGANIZATION'S WEBSITE. ALL INFORMATION IS AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
THERE HAVE BEEN NO CHANGES FROM THE PRIOR YEAR IN THE OVERSIGHT OR SELECTION PROCESSES FOR THE AUDIT THAT THE ORGANIZATION'S COMMITTEE USES.
